name: Jamming & Spoofing Detection
description: Ability to detect, characterize, and locate RF jamming and spoofing activity targeting satellite navigation and communication systems. Covers jammer signal classification, direction-finding techniques, spoofing indicator analysis, interference power measurement, and assessment of anti-jam and anti-spoof countermeasure effectiveness.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to jamming or spoofing detection techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands RF jamming and spoofing threat types and their impact on satellite systems
evidence: Can describe common jammer types (broadband, narrowband, swept, pulsed) and their effects
Understands the observable indicators of GNSS spoofing versus jamming
Completed training on RF interference detection and characterization

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Detects and classifies controlled jamming and spoofing signals under supervision
evidence: Identified jamming signals in spectrum analyzer displays and characterized their parameters under guidance
Distinguished between jamming and spoofing indicators in GNSS receiver telemetry under supervision
Measured interference power levels and calculated jammer-to-signal ratios with assistance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently detects, classifies, and documents RF interference events
evidence: Independently detected and characterized jamming events in 3+ field or lab assessments
Classified jammer types from spectrum captures and documented signal parameters
Applied direction-finding techniques to estimate interference source location
Produced interference analysis reports with spectral evidence and source characterization

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced interference analysis; evaluates anti-jam countermeasure effectiveness
evidence: Assessed anti-jam receiver performance (CRPA, beam-steering, adaptive nulling) under controlled interference
Characterized sophisticated or adaptive jammer behavior through time-frequency analysis
Developed automated interference detection and alerting systems
Mentors junior analysts on interference characterization and geolocation techniques

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on RF interference analysis; defines detection methodology; advises on resilience
evidence: Published research on jamming detection, spoofing detection, or interference mitigation techniques
Authored the lab's RF interference analysis and detection methodology
Advises on critical infrastructure RF resilience and anti-jam architecture
Trains teams on interference detection and develops lab interference analysis capabilities

assessment_methods.description: Detect, classify, and geolocate controlled interference sources in a lab or field environment, documenting signal parameters and source characteristics
Given spectrum captures of an unknown interference event, classify the interference type, estimate source parameters, and recommend countermeasures

equipment: Spectrum analyzer with interference detection modes
Controlled RF signal generator for interference simulation
